findings.title: Container is denied access to a mounted volume
findings.cause: container web runs as user 1000 and is denied access to /data/ready on volume state (hostPath /var/lib/kd-volume-permission-denied): "touch: /data/ready: Permission denied"; hostPath /var/lib/kd-volume-permission-denied belongs to the node, and fsGroup does not change its owner; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container web's log (run that exited)
container web mounts volume state (hostPath /var/lib/kd-volume-permission-denied) at /data

findings.fix: Give /var/lib/kd-volume-permission-denied on the node to user 1000, or chown it from an init container that runs as root, or run the container as the directory's owner. fsGroup does not apply to hostPath volumes.
